# CodexMate 0.0.19
- Show a smooth three-dot loading indicator in the notch while the initial thread list is bootstrapping. - Block notch menu expansion during initial thread bootstrap so clicking the pixel character cannot interrupt the first load. - Trust session-backed running evidence for watched threads so active desktop sessions stay marked as running after terminal completion hints. - Added regression coverage for initial menu gating and session-backed running state handling.
